data.name: Shreyash Naik
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Shreyash Naik has made a big mark in cricket. With 10 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 24*, with an average of 11.86 and a quick strike rate of 109.21. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 1 sixes and 8 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 19.5 overs, taking 9 wickets at an economy rate of 9.48. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
